reports.title: Lumexa Imaging Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Full Year Outlook
section: Lumexa Imaging provided an update on its guidance for the full year ended December 31, 2026.
• | Reiterating full-year 2026 consolidated revenue guidance of $1.045 billion to $1.097 billion.

• | Narrowing its full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance range to $236 million to $240 million, from its prior range of $235 million to $241 million. The midpoint of $238 million is unchanged. This includes approximately $7 million of public company costs that were not incurred in 2025. (At the midpoint of guidance, the addition of these costs lowers Adjusted EBITDA growth for 2026 versus 2025 from 7% to 4%)
• | Raising guidance for Adjusted EPS to $0.86 to $0.90 from $0.71 to $0.77 per share, driven by lower assumed effective tax rate.

desk.headline: Revenue up 5% to $272.0m, beat; adjusted EPS $0.26 beat; EPS outlook raised, EBITDA range narrowed
results: Revenue rose 5% to $272.0m, ahead of the $269.9m estimate; including joint-venture centres, system-wide revenue grew 7.7%.
Higher-value MRI and CT scans grew 8.1% system-wide and reached a record 38.2% of all scans.
Net income was $7.2m against a $3.5m loss a year ago, helped by interest costs halving to $15.7m after debt was paid down with IPO money.
Adjusted EBITDA rose 6% to $62.6m, with the margin edging up to 23.0%.
Cash rose to $90.0m; long-term debt was $821.5m.

guidance.summary: Lumexa raised its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook on a lower expected tax rate, narrowed its adjusted EBITDA range around the same $238m midpoint and kept its revenue range.

points: Three new centres opened in early November, five so far this year; the 8–10 target for 2026 stands.
The 2027 Medicare fee cut looks like about 1%, but nearly all 2027 commercial rate talks are done.
The higher EPS outlook comes from tax, not operations; operating assumptions are unchanged.
Net leverage fell to 3.5 times EBITDA from 5.6 a year ago; Q3 free cash flow was about $20.6m.
Formal 2027 guidance is due in March; a new joint venture takes the company into Illinois.
call.source: Q3 2026 call transcript — Earnings Whispers, 10 Nov 2026

watch: Whether new centres hit the 8–10 opening target and ramp as planned.
The effect of Medicare rate cuts on 2027 pricing.
Debt reduction and free cash flow staying above 30% of EBITDA.
